description: This file defines a Python class 'LocalVectorStore' that manages a FAISS-based vector index for storing, searching, saving, and loading embeddings along with associated metadata. It includes methods for adding embeddings, searching for similar vectors with optional filtering, persisting the index to disk, and retrieving statistics about the stored vectors.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class implementing a FAISS-based local vector store for embedding management, search, and persistence.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the vector store with a specified dimension and creates a FAISS index.

methods.name: add_embeddings
methods.description: Adds a list of embeddings and their metadata to the index.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for similar vectors given a query embedding, with optional filtering by chapter.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the index and metadata to disk at a specified path.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the index and metadata from disk from a specified path.

methods.name: get_stats
methods.description: Returns statistics about the stored vectors, including total count, dimension, and metadata count.
